scene.speaker: tomas
scene.bubble: Run! The monkeys are so funny! And look, Pip — that big bird looks just like you!
scene.intro: Today the Explorers visit the zoo, and Tomás is running from one animal to the next! The monkeys are jumping, the big grey elephant is eating a banana, and the lion is sleeping — shhh! Pip flies up high to say hello to the zoo birds, because birds understand birds. Can you say the names of all the animals? Can you make their sounds? Woof, meow, roar… let's go in!

words.clue: You can ride it. It says neigh!
It has wings and can fly.

activities.title: Match the animal with its sound.
Listen to Tomás at the zoo. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Freya: Tomás, look! Monkeys! … Tomas: Wow! One, two, three, four… there are five monkeys! … Freya: What are they doing? … Tomas: They are jumping! I can jump too, look! … Freya: Ha ha! And look at that elephant. It's very big. … Tomas: It's grey and it's eating a banana. … Freya: Can you see the ducks? … Tomas: Yes! There are two yellow ducks in the water. … Freya: And where is Pip? … Tomas: Look up! He's flying with the big birds!
